tiers.foundation: Cross-component visual or behavioral rule implemented once and reused broadly.
tiers.core: Approved Specular component or product pattern to include in the initial library.
tiers.conditional: Named recipe retained in the registry but not implemented until a concrete Specular use requires it.
tiers.excluded: Catalog pattern intentionally excluded by the current product model or interface doctrine.

entries.name: Steps
entries.use: Only for a real multi-stage recovery, migration, or onboarding flow; never substitute for tabs, breadcrumbs, or determinate progress.

entries.name: Avatar Group
entries.use: Specular has one private author workspace and no collaboration or social-presence model.

entries.name: Multi-select
entries.use: Reserve for future bounded metadata or bulk-selection needs; current snapshot inclusion remains explicit checkboxes.

entries.name: Scrollspy
entries.use: Potentially useful for long hosted snapshots or help content; it is in-page navigation, not tabs.

entries.name: Inline Alert vs. Callout vs. Banner
entries.use: Persistent task errors, authored explanatory notes, and rare workspace-wide conditions must remain distinct from toasts.

entries.name: Sign-in Form
entries.use: Product-specific single ChatGPT sign-in handoff; do not introduce email, password, passkey, or social-provider form fields.

entries.name: Pagination
entries.use: Introduce only when a bounded collection actually spans addressable pages.

entries.name: Date Picker
entries.use: No current product need; prefer the native control before a custom calendar when a date decision emerges.

entries.name: Parallax Scrolling
entries.use: Conflicts with the quiet authored workspace and adds motion without helping an author understand state.

entries.name: Carousel
entries.use: Specular has no rotating media or peer-slide requirement; avoid hiding core content behind sequential slides.

entries.name: Site Header vs. Navigation Bar
entries.use: Keep the page header landmark distinct from its document/Connections navigation.

entries.name: Card
entries.use: Use only for a bounded object preview such as a hosted snapshot; do not turn every region into a beige card.

entries.name: Resize Handle (Size Grip)
entries.use: Allow vertical resizing only where it improves writing; bound dimensions and preserve mobile layout.

entries.name: Hamburger Menu (Nav Drawer)
entries.use: Use only if mobile primary navigation outgrows visible actions; the trigger and navigation drawer are separate parts.

entries.name: Bento Grid
entries.use: A dashboard-like bento composition conflicts with the document-first product and the anti-vibe-coded direction.

entries.name: Masonry Layout (Pinterest Grid)
entries.use: Packed visual order is inappropriate for canonical writing, Connections, and accessibility-sensitive reading order.

entries.name: Easing (Timing Function)
entries.use: Centralize restrained entry, exit, and continuity curves with reduced-motion equivalents.

entries.name: Spring Animation
entries.use: Only for meaningful spatial continuity; never ambient bounce or decorative overshoot.

entries.name: Text Scramble (Decode Effect)
entries.use: Conflicts with legibility, authorship trust, reduced motion, and the non-theatrical interface doctrine.

entries.name: Lightbox
entries.use: Retain for a future source/image preview; no current media requirement justifies implementation.

entries.name: Marquee
entries.use: Continuous promotional motion conflicts with concentration, legibility, and reduced-motion expectations.

entries.name: Form Field
entries.use: Visible labels, linked help/error text, field-scoped dictation, and editable correction are foundational authoring patterns.

entries.name: Truncation (Ellipsis & Line Clamp)
entries.use: Allow only in constrained metadata/list rows with an accessible full-value path; never truncate canonical writing.

entries.name: Drag & Drop
entries.use: Potential future block movement or attachment intake; requires equivalent keyboard controls and durable ordering semantics.

entries.name: Divider vs. Separator vs. Rule
entries.use: Choose semantics from purpose: topic break, structural control separation, or purely visual border.

entries.name: Progress Ring vs. Spinner vs. Progress Bar
entries.use: No current determinate-progress surface exists. Promote only for a known measurable process; indeterminate Spinner remains core through the Skeleton vs. Spinner entry.

entries.name: The Three Dots (Overflow Menu)
entries.use: Secondary contextual actions use a labeled ellipsis menu; do not confuse it with navigation or truncation.

entries.name: Toast (Snackbar)
entries.use: Only transient nonessential outcomes; pause dismissal while hovered or focused and never replace persistent recovery guidance.

entries.name: Modal Dialog vs. Drawer vs. Sheet
entries.use: Select by task depth and placement; every modal variant shares containment, dismissal, inertness, and focus restoration.

entries.name: Popover vs. Dropdown Menu vs. Tooltip
entries.use: Tooltip labels controls, menu invokes commands, and popover holds richer interactive content; they are not interchangeable.

entries.name: Scrim (Backdrop / Overlay)
entries.use: One shared modal backdrop and layering contract; visual dimming must match actual modality.

entries.name: Skeleton vs. Spinner
entries.use: Skeleton reserves a predictable layout; spinner represents bounded indeterminate work. Neither may mask an error or settled empty state.

entries.name: Combobox (Autocomplete / Typeahead)
entries.use: Potential future source, document, or connection search; implement only with a concrete selection model.

entries.name: Command Palette
entries.use: Potential expert accelerator after core actions and shortcuts stabilize; never the only route to an action.

entries.name: Accordion (Disclosure)
entries.use: Use native disclosure for optional explanation such as privacy or provenance; frequent primary actions stay visible.

entries.name: Tabs
entries.use: Only peer views sharing one region; do not use for route navigation, sequential flow, or persistent filters.

entries.name: Badge vs. Chip vs. Pill vs. Tag
entries.use: Choose by behavior; Specular has no generic decorative Pill component. Generated metadata remains provenance-aware.

entries.name: Breadcrumbs
entries.use: No current hierarchy is deep enough; retain only for a future nested information architecture.

entries.name: Sticky vs. Fixed Positioning
entries.use: Prefer sticky within the owning scroll context; fixed surfaces require collision, safe-area, keyboard, and focus checks.

entries.name: Focus Ring (:focus-visible)
entries.use: One visible high-contrast keyboard-focus contract across controls, overlays, and surfaces.

entries.name: Empty State
entries.use: Differentiate first use, no results, loading, and failure; provide the most useful next author action without blame.

entries.name: Hover Card
entries.use: Potential source/provenance preview only if an equivalent focus and touch path exists.

entries.name: Switch vs. Checkbox vs. Radio
entries.use: Switch applies immediately, checkbox represents independent or deferred selection, and radio chooses exactly one option.

entries.name: Toggle Group (Segmented Control)
entries.use: Compact persistent selection among a small peer set, such as a Connections scope; not a route navigator or action row.
